title: LLM-Assisted Optimization for Simulation-Based Redesign
abstract: arXiv:2610.39275v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Engineering design frequently involves redesigning a prior solution to adapt to changes in context, such as material prices or system requirements. Redesign often leverages simulators too complex and/or computationally intensive for traditional numerical solvers, which lack engineering knowledge and context, to ensure global solution quality. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret semantic information, including engineering knowledge about the system and changes in context, to help guide search, and recent studies have shown that incorporating this knowledge into optimization can improve search performance. However, how best to combine LLMs with numerical solvers in redesign remains unclear. translated_title: 面向仿真驱动再设计的大语言模型辅助优化方法
translated_abstract: 工程设计经常需要对已有方案进行再设计，以适应环境的变化，例如材料价格或系统需求的变动。再设计通常依赖于过于复杂和/或计算量过大的仿真器，而传统的数值求解器缺乏工程知识和背景信息，难以保证全局解的质量。大语言模型（LLM）能够理解语义信息，包括关于系统的工程知识和环境变化，从而帮助引导搜索，近期研究表明，将这些知识融入优化过程可以提升搜索性能。然而，在再设计任务中如何最佳地结合大语言模型与数值求解器仍不明确。本文开发并测试了一种用于再设计的集成式“大语言模型-优化”方法，比较了三种利用大语言模型的方式（热启动、变量固定和ReAct）以及四种黑盒求解器（贝叶斯优化、遗传算法、网格自适应直接搜索等）。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种将大语言模型与黑盒数值求解器相结合的集成优化框架，用于仿真驱动的工程再设计，并系统比较了三种LLM利用方式与四种求解器的组合效果。
en_tdlr: This paper develops and tests an integrated LLM-optimization framework for simulation-based engineering redesign, systematically comparing three ways of leveraging LLMs (warm start, variable fixing, and ReAct) with four black-box solvers.
